verdict.rationale: Google Calendar has a broad REST API covering events, recurring-event instances, secondary calendars, ACLs, colors, free/busy, incremental sync and push notifications. However, its own docs say the API exposes only "most" of the web UI's features, so full UI parity is explicitly not claimed. missing for 10: documented full UI-to-API parity, API evidence for UI features such as appointment booking pages, independent or hands-on corroboration of coverage breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The API exposes most of the features available in the Google Calendar Web interface.
The Google Calendar API is a RESTful API that can be accessed through explicit HTTP calls or using the Google Client Libraries.
